entities.name: Wang Yi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wang Yi is a Chinese volleyball player who twice went to the Olympic Games with the Chinese team, in 1992 and 1996. She helped the Chinese team win the silver medal at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta.
